fields.label: Colour Code
fields.description: Short code used in SKU, e.g. WHT, BLU, GRN

fields.label: Approved for Production
fields.description: Ticked by default - untick to exclude this colour from the SKU/BOM matrix without deleting it. Drives whether matrix rows get created for this colour at all.

fields.label: Colour Attribute Value
fields.description: Bridge to native ERPNext variants. Set this to the matching Item Attribute Value (attribute 'Colour') so BOM lines with Resolution Rule 'Match garment colour' can auto-resolve item variants by attribute match instead of a manual lookup.
